symptom:
Two replicas, a primary and a backup (server/main.go). The primary forwards each ADD id to the backup and appends it to its own log, answering with the new count; retried ids must be applied once. The client sends 40 adds, retrying each until acknowledged and saving its progress, and may itself be crashed and resend the add that was in flight. Faults (crashes, pauses, partitions, connection resets) run for the first 5s of virtual time, then stop and all nodes are restarted and healed; a final check compares both counts with the number of adds the client sent.

Observed on seed 1: connections between the replicas were reset five times and the backup was crashed once. After faults stopped, the final check failed: liveness: primary and backup report the same count: not true within 5s. The client had finished and been acknowledged for every add.

Expected: once faults stop, both replicas must hold every acknowledged add and report the same count.
